entities.name: Haliya
entities.description: Syr Vondam's squire in the Sunstar Free Company, who goes alone into Taro-duend to stop Alpharael, refuses to order a massacre, and is ultimately felled by Alpharael.

entities.name: Syr Vondam
entities.description: A Solar Knight who survived a black hole through his skull, fears he is an anstruth under the object's influence, and directs the search for Alpharael.

entities.name: Alpharael
entities.description: A fugitive Monoist who wakes on the Seriema with a hole through his right hand, hears the voice of the object, and has the stone's help in escape.

entities.name: Sami
entities.description: Captain of the Seriema who deduces that the stone makes them lucky, but is later shot by Haliya as they return to the ship.

entities.name: Tannuk
entities.description: Sami's Kav first mate who hides Sami under his poncho from the Free Company and is later shot by Haliya.

entities.name: Quinidad
entities.description: A squire who taught Haliya to see in battle.

entities.name: Cataphrin
entities.description: An acquaintance of Haliya who would explain Summist interpretation of situations.

entities.name: Santaphor
entities.description: A figure Haliya imagines would pretend not to understand and ask for explanations.

entities.name: Isidor
entities.description: A figure Haliya imagines would leap into action.

entities.name: Raphaella
entities.description: Alpharael's twin sister who plunged into the Next Eternity.

entities.name: Slats
entities.description: The Dawnsire's Astelli captain, who foresaw Vondam's death; Vondam left without telling him.

entities.name: The Metalman
entities.description: The patron to whom Sami intends to deliver the stone.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: Someone Sami wants the Metalman to help find.

entities.name: The Metalman's artifact
entities.description: A stone that speaks to Alpharael in a dream, lets him pass his finger through a hole in his hand, and bends luck and past events around him.

entities.name: Anathalmanac
entities.description: A catalog of terrors given to Vondam and Haliya that lays out protocols for handling the object, including radiant resignation.

entities.name: Sundog
entities.description: The Sunstar palestar that carries Vondam and Haliya to Taro-duend.

entities.name: Seriema
entities.description: Sami's ship, hidden in a cave off the slag fields, where Alpharael wakes and where Haliya finds him.

entities.name: Dawnsire
entities.description: The Sunstar ship Vondam and Haliya left in secret.

entities.name: Taro-duend
entities.description: A Kav settlement on stilts on Kavaron That Is where the Free Company searches for Alpharael and the Kav resist.

entities.name: Kavaron
entities.description: The ruined Kav world where the story takes place.

entities.name: Uthros
entities.description: The place Sami and Tannuk are to meet the Metalman, for which their ship lacks fuel.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: The dead star system the Sunstar mission hopes to reignite and where the object is believed to be.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: The Sunstar fighting order searching Taro-duend for Alpharael.

entities.name: Monoism
entities.description: The faith of Alpharael, believing all futures end in black holes.

entities.name: INEVITA
entities.description: What survives at the end of time; a deity Monoists beg to draw them down.

entities.name: Anstruth
entities.description: A blasphemy against reality, an outcome engineered by the object.

entities.name: The Sum
entities.description: The Sunstar measure of life that must be increased, treated as a real hard figure.

entities.name: Moratorio Cosmogrand
entities.description: A Sunstar unit whose photophoroi help Haliya make her first combat descent.

events.summary: Haliya, aboard the Sundog, stares guiltily at the hole in Vondam's skull and thinks of Alpharael.
events.quote: Haliya catches herself staring at the hole in Syr Vondam's skull again.

events.summary: Vondam and Haliya left the Dawnsire in a secret rush, telling no one, not even Captain Slats.
events.quote: They left the Dawnsire in a secret rush, telling no one, not even Captain Slats.

events.summary: Vondam says they are going to find and kill Alpharael, not for revenge.
events.quote: All he will say is that they are going to find and kill Alpharael.

events.summary: Vondam orders the Sundog to repeat its demand that Taro-duend hand over the spy and to launch Hopelights for surveillance.
events.quote: Give them another chance to hand over the spy. Launch the Hopelights.

events.summary: Vondam gives Haliya a quartz crystal containing the anathalmanac.
events.quote: He gives her a quartz memory crystal.

events.summary: Vondam explains his belief that an anathema object in Sothera is calling for a wielder and threatens the Sunstar mission.
events.quote: I believe one such object is in Sothera.

events.summary: Vondam says the object manipulated Slats's vision, Vondam's death and survival to draw Alpharael to it.
events.quote: The object manipulated everything.

events.summary: Haliya reads protocol seven, radiant resignation, requiring destruction of everything the object touches.
events.quote: 7. Radiant resignation. Destroy yourself, all those about you, and the Object, by the most immediate and violent means available.

events.summary: Vondam declares that his judgment cannot be trusted and Haliya is now effectively the knight.
events.quote: In a sense, Haliya, you are now the knight and I the squire.

events.summary: Vondam asks Haliya whether she could order the destruction of all Taro-duend if needed.
events.quote: Can you destroy it all?

events.summary: Haliya refuses to help kill a settlement of innocents.
events.quote: I won't do it. I'm not going to kill a settlement full of defenseless innocents.

events.summary: Haliya proposes to go down to Taro-duend herself to find and kill Alpharael.
events.quote: You don't go down there. I do.

events.summary: Haliya persuades Vondam to let her go in his place by invoking a knight's trust.
events.quote: He would give her a chance to be worthy of his trust.

events.summary: Alpharael dreams of his past and his twin Raphaella being chosen for the Plummet, while a voice speaks to him.
events.quote: One twin cast into the singularity. One twin turned away.

events.summary: The voice reveals Alpharael has already used it, changing the Hopelight's past so the Kav arrived as walking corpses.
events.quote: Alpharael's used me already, to get rid of the Kav.

events.summary: The voice tells Alpharael why he was meant to wield it.
events.quote: Do you understand, Alpharael, why you were meant to wield me?

events.summary: Alpharael wakes strapped in a bunk on the Seriema.
events.quote: "I live," he croaks.

events.summary: Alpharael discovers a transparent hole through his right hand.
events.quote: A hole right through his hand, palm to dorsum.

events.summary: Alpharael sees Sunstar Free Company knights and photophoroi landing at Taro-duend to search for him.
events.quote: And from that ship rains an armored rain: the tiny figures of Solar Knights descending on spikes of plasma.

events.summary: Alpharael finds Sami's note saying they are out for fuel and he is locked in.
events.quote: Gone out for fuel—back soon.

events.summary: Alpharael unlocks his cabin hatch by threading a finger through the hole in his hand.
events.quote: He drives his left index finger through the hole in his right hand.

events.summary: Alpharael goes to the cargo bay and restarts the stasis cask to retrieve what is inside.
events.quote: He rubs at the hole in his hand as the cask whirs up to real time.

events.summary: The Free Company sweeps Taro-duend with drones and infantry.
events.quote: The Free Company is everywhere.

events.summary: The Kav of Taro-duend resist the Free Company by sabotage and obstruction.
events.quote: In an act of aggressive, unilateral solidarity, the Kav are raising thirteen kinds of hell.

events.summary: Tannuk hides Sami under his poncho as they move through the chaos.
events.quote: You could not ask for a better first mate or a worse fugitive than Tannuk.

events.summary: Sami concludes the stone is making them lucky enough to avoid detection.
events.quote: It's the rock, Tannuk. The rock is lucky.

events.summary: A Free Company officer fires a microwave weapon on the crowd.
events.quote: One of the Free Company officers fires up a microwave weapon.

events.summary: Sami speculates that a similar past rewrite emptied Sigma's Reach of its people.
events.quote: Maybe there were people there, before we showed up.

events.summary: Sami refuses to give up the stone because the Metalman is their hope of finding Mirri.
events.quote: then he wouldn't fix our ship. And then who'd look for Mirri?

events.summary: Haliya makes her first combat descent to Taro-duend alone.
events.quote: A team of photophoroi from the Moratorio Cosmogrand help her make her first combat descent.

events.summary: Haliya builds a triple-jointed pendulum to shield herself from the object by tying her actions to scripture.
events.quote: 3. Pendulum, encoding faith. Fashion from gleanings a triple-jointed pendulum. Dangle it from thy armor.

events.summary: In the third cave she checks, Haliya finds the Seriema.
events.quote: In the third cave she checks, she finds a ship called the Seriema

events.summary: Haliya plants charges on the Seriema before going in.
events.quote: Plant a charge under the Seriema 's folded airfoil.

events.summary: Alpharael tries to wish on the stone for rescue but nothing happens.
events.quote: Bring Captain Sami back here safely. Get us off this planet and away from the Sunstar knights.

events.summary: Haliya enters the cargo bay and Alpharael tries to banish her with the stone.
events.quote: Alpharael brandishes the rock at her and shouts, "Vanish!"

events.summary: Haliya stuns Alpharael with her bladiator.
events.quote: The bright figure shoots him.

events.summary: Haliya puts a dead-man bomb in Alpharael's mouth to protect herself from the object's influence.
events.quote: That's a bomb," she says. "If it doesn't get my passcode every ten seconds, it'll blow up.

events.summary: Haliya asks Alpharael to use the object to change the past so she was the one he killed, sparing Vondam.
events.quote: I need you to change things so that I was the one you killed

events.summary: The Free Company search at Taro-duend collapses under Kav resistance.
events.quote: The Free Company search is falling apart.

events.summary: A Hopelight pilot destroys half the airport while firing at a laser source.
events.quote: I blew up half the airport .

events.summary: Haliya urges Alpharael to change the past.
events.quote: "Do it," she urges him.

events.summary: Haliya tells Vondam she has Alpharael and offers to be the one the object changed.
events.quote: I can be the one it changed. You can be yourself again.

events.summary: Vondam orders Haliya to kill Alpharael and return with the object.
events.quote: Haliya, I am ordering you to kill him and return with the object.

events.summary: Haliya tells Vondam to proceed with protocol seven and fire on her, the object and the Kav.
events.quote: You have to fire. Destroy me, the object, and the Kav.

events.summary: Vondam orders Haliya to get out and move to the slag field for extraction.
events.quote: Move to the slag field for extraction.

events.summary: As a human and a Kav, apparently Sami and Tannuk, reach the Seriema's ramp, Haliya shoots the human through the heart.
events.quote: She lases the human through the heart.

events.summary: Haliya kills the grieving Kav, apparently Tannuk, with her bladiator.
events.quote: It takes a surprisingly long fraction of a second for her bladiator to burn through the Kav's throat and kill it, too.

events.summary: Alpharael jabs himself with a jet injector and the injection passes through the hole in his hand and into Haliya, paralyzing her.
events.quote: Only the injection has gone through his hand, through her armor, and into her .

relations.quote: All he will say is that they are going to find and kill Alpharael.

relations.note: Haliya blames Alpharael for Vondam's wound.
relations.quote: She let the coward Alpharael throw a black hole through her knight's skull.

relations.note: Quinidad taught Haliya to see in battle.
relations.quote: little Quinidad who taught Haliya how to see in battle
shot from his artificial womb alongside his twin sister
You could not ask for a better first mate or a worse fugitive than Tannuk.

relations.note: The object chooses Alpharael as its wielder.
relations.quote: Do you understand, Alpharael, why you were meant to wield me?
